# SbcSharp attribution

The files in this directory are derived from [Ylianst/SbcSharp](https://github.com/Ylianst/SbcSharp)
at commit `8fd1417b142bb1be69b119c23ccfac360ee15ef4`.

SbcSharp is licensed under the Apache License 2.0. DS4Windows vendors the codec
sources to encode the DualShock 4 Bluetooth speaker stream and decode its SBC
microphone stream. Integration-only changes are identified in each source file.
